en: Unverified distribution

en: The verified distribution type is unrecognized.

source: 仅支持官方 ProcessKeeper 便携包或安装包。
en: Only official ProcessKeeper portable packages or installers are supported.

source: 此更新文件不支持当前系统或处理器架构。
en: This update file does not support the current operating system or processor architecture.

source: 兼容界面
en: Compatibility UI

source: 所选文件与当前版本类型不同，更新后将切换版本类型。
en: The selected package differs from this edition. Updating will switch editions.

source: 切换更新包类型？
en: Switch update edition?

source: 所选更新包与当前运行的包类型不同，可能改变安装方式或兼容界面。确认后继续。
en: The selected update differs from the running edition and may change the installation method or compatibility interface. Confirm to continue.

source: 请选择发布文件。
en: Select a release file.

source: 退出并启动安装程序
en: Exit and open installer

source: 安装向导中的完成或取消由你决定；取消后原有 EXE 会保留。
en: Complete or cancel the setup wizard yourself. Cancelling retains the original EXE.

source: 当前安装目录会继续更新，原有卸载入口与安装状态会保留。
en: The current installation folder will be updated. Its uninstall entry and installed status are retained.

source: 如需独立的免安装副本，请另外手动下载到其他目录。
en: For a separate portable copy, manually download it to another folder.

source: 所选更新包不支持当前系统或运行方式。
en: The selected update does not support this system or distribution.

source: 请确认退出并启动安装程序。
en: Confirm to exit and open the installer.

source: 点击“退出并启动安装程序”后，Process Keeper 将退出并打开标准安装向导。请在安装向导中确认安装位置并完成更新。其他应用不会因此退出。
en: Click Exit and open installer to close Process Keeper and open the standard setup wizard. Confirm the installation location in the wizard and complete the update. Other applications will stay open.

source: 清理旧版本缓存、遗留更新包与未完成下载；使用中的文件、白名单和设置会保留。
en: Remove old version caches, leftover update packages and incomplete downloads. Files in use, whitelist rules and settings are retained.

source: 没有可清理的应用缓存或更新包。
en: There are no removable application caches or update packages.

source: 卸载完成并核实注册项已移除后，只会清理已确认归属且为空的安装目录；其他文件和上级目录会保留。
en: After uninstall completes and its registration is verified as removed, only the verified empty installation folder is cleaned. Other files and parent folders are retained.

source: 已移除经核实为空的安装目录。
en: The verified empty installation folder was removed.

source: 未额外清理安装目录；无法确认归属、共享或非空的目录会保留。
en: No installation folder was additionally removed. Unverified, shared or nonempty folders are retained.
